scenes.h1: Quran classes that fit a UAE school day
scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum to families in Dubai, Sharjah, Abu Dhabi and across the Emirates.
Popular times are after school, between 3 pm and 8 pm UAE time, or weekend mornings.
Every class is live, one to one and 30 minutes, from your own home.
Teachers explain in English, Arabic or Urdu, and female teachers are available on request.
In Ramadan, many families move classes to after iftar or before suhoor.
Book a free trial class at nurulhudaacademy.org
